{{Quote|I've just killed a man... We may have a bit of pull in this system; I suspect we're going to need it.|Lando Calrissian to Vuffi Raa|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
'''Kenow''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as part of the [[Renatasian Confederation]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kenow grew up on a farm in the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]], before joining military service in time to serve in the bloody [[Battle of the Rood]]. Kenow survived, in doing so forming a lifelong bond with a fellow farmboy named [[Klyn Shanga]], and embarked on a career as a soldier that resulted in him reaching the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] invaded and brutally subjugated the Renatasia system during the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], leading Kenow and Shanga to help form a vigilante group called the Renatasian Confederation, which was sworn to hunt down the "[[Butcher of Renatasia]]"&mdash;the individual who supposedly betrayed Renatasia to the Empire, whom they identified as the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Vuffi Raa]].<ref name="LCFO" />

After a years-long hunt, Kenow, Shanga and what remained of the Confederation finally tracked Raa to the wealthy [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]], specifically finding Raa's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oseon 6845]]. As the Oseon had extremely strict weapons laws, Kenow sneaked into the ''Millennium Falcon's'' [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] armed only with a large [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] pipe. Instead of Raa, Kenow encountered Raa's new master, the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]&mdash;although the Colonel got the drop on Calrissian, the man produced a hidden [[Stingbeam/Legends|stingbeam]] weapon and fired it into Kenow at close range, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him instantly.<ref name="LCFO" />
